About the Buildathon

A nationwide buildathon for founders and aspiring entrepreneurs with a startup idea they want to build and scale. Over the program you turn that idea into a working product, backed by Google’s AI stack and infrastructure, hands-on mentorship, startup grant and credits, and access to investors.
